subject.title: perf: measure and reduce the shared route entry bundle

question: Should the team treat the measured no-go as the stopping point, or sponsor one specifically named next route-entry extraction hypothesis?
rationale: The first bounded experiment met its stop condition, and choosing another import boundary or broader performance target is product/performance prioritization rather than a mechanically implied repair.

options.title: Stop after the no-go
options.body: Keep the measured result as the decision record and revisit only when profiling identifies a concrete cross-route dependency that can plausibly leave the initial closure.

options.title: Sponsor a replacement A/B
options.body: Name one route/import boundary, a minimum compressed-closure reduction, and browser-navigation proof requirements before starting a new focused experiment.

recommendation.title: Stop after the no-go
recommendation.body: Keep the measured result as the decision record and revisit only when profiling identifies a concrete cross-route dependency that can plausibly leave the initial closure.

likelyOwner.reason: They supplied the measurement methodology and have recent merged history in the adjacent catalog-loading performance path.
